outcomeNote: Mishna statement of practice and a Beit Shammai/Beit Hillel dispute

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: בִּיהוּדָה הָיוּ עוֹשִׂין מְלָאכָה בְּעַרְבֵי פְסָחִים עַד חֲצוֹת, וּבַגָּלִיל לֹא הָיוּ עוֹשִׂין כׇּל עִיקָּר. הַלַּיְלָה, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹסְרִים, וּבֵית הִלֵּל מַתִּירִין עַד הָנֵץ הַחַמָּה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Apropos the discussion of performing labor on Passover eve, differences in other customs were cited. «And the Rabbis say: In Judea,» people «would perform labor on Passover eves until midday, and in the Galilee» people «would not perform» labor on Passover eve «at all.» With regard to performing labor on «the night» before Passover eve, the night between the thirteenth and fourteenth of Nisan, «Beit Shammai prohibit» performing labor, «and Beit Hillel permit» doing so «until sunrise.»

moves.summary: Judea works until midday, the Galilee not at all
Beit Shammai forbid labor on the night
